name: Abraham Isaac
overview: The narrative of Abraham and Isaac highlights God's faithfulness and the testing of Abraham's faith. In Genesis 21:1, God fulfills His promise by visiting Sarah and enabling the birth of Isaac, demonstrating His trustworthiness. Later, in Genesis 22:1, God tests Abraham by commanding him to offer Isaac, to which Abraham responds with obedient readiness. Hebrews 11:17 reflects on this act as a profound expression of faith, where Abraham, trusting in God's promises, is willing to offer his only son.
